name: Dapple
author: E. T. Carter
description: Sunlight through a drifting mat of surface foliage: a sparse constellation of discrete, soft-edged elliptical sun-flecks on a near-black seabed, all sharing one projection slant and each tinted by position. A passing swell sways the whole constellation in coherent lockstep while fronds blink individual flecks out and back, and now and then one fleck pinches smoothly into two.

params.label: Sway speed
params.effect: Speed of the swell rocking the fleck constellation and pacing the occlusion blinks, from dead-calm noon to a breezy chop.

params.label: Fleck size
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of one sun-fleck — small gives a fine freckling of leaf-light, large gives a few broad pools of sun.

params.label: Cover
params.effect: Fraction of the floor shaded by the overhead mat — 0 scatters flecks broadly across the frame, 0.9 leaves only a handful of survivors in deep shade.
